Notes.Text:
This update for openvpn fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-11771: NTLM proxy auth stack off-by-one write (bsc#1273126).
- CVE-2026-12932: memory leak using --tls-crypt-v2 (bsc#1273127).
- CVE-2026-12996: Potential DoS and memory leak via TLS session use-after-free (bsc#1273128).
- CVE-2026-13117: Heap use-after-free via incomplete guard in check_session_buf_not_used() (bsc#1273129).
- CVE-2026-13379: Windows interactive service DNS SearchList state pollution (bsc#1273130).
- CVE-2026-35058: improper validation of packet length can lead to a denial of service (bsc#1267945).
- CVE-2026-40215: race condition during TLS session promotion can lead to a use-after-free (bsc#1267944).
